title: A Language for the Wardrobe
author: Y. M. Underhill
blurb: Yara Brightwater, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when the last speaker of a language asks for one final student, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
